objective: Compare current credible research and official implementations with bounded ACR evidence without copying code, running external artifacts, or authorizing integration.
verification_requirements: Cover every fixed Prompt 99 topic with a finding or an evidence-backed no-relevant-finding result.
Prefer original research, official repositories, and maintainer documentation and bind each source to retrieval date and content hash.
Separate research claims, documented implementations, and ACR-reproduced engineering results.
Report novelty, source-code and license status, ACR differences, safe adaptations, prohibited copying, expected improvement, integration cost, and a baseline/candidate/quality/security benchmark.
Do not fetch, execute, install, copy, authorize, or persist external artifacts from this unbound template.
